description: This Java class `MessageOnlyLogFilter` implements the `LogNode` interface to filter log messages, passing only the message content and ignoring metadata. It is used to create a simpler log output, typically for on-screen display, by chaining log nodes.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that passes only the message string to the next log node in the chain.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor accepting the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters the log message by passing only the message content to the next LogNode, ignoring other metadata.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
